name: decimator_fir
description: 63-tap FIR then keep the outputs at odd raw indices: decimated[k] = sum_j taps[j]*x[2k+1-j], j = 0..62 ascending, float32, x[n<0] = 0. decimated[k] describes raw index 2k + raw_offset. Lost raw samples (valid = false; zeros in the input, as a WAV stores them) are replaced inside the FIR by the previous good raw sample (0 if none yet); expected_valid[k] is false when any raw sample in the FIR window 2k+1-62 .. 2k+1 was lost (the node counts it as device_dropped and does not send it); expected also holds those invalid outputs. Lost runs [a, b): [0, 3), [1001, 1002), [1300, 1302), [1700, 1707), [2500, 2540) (the first one before any good sample). expected_codes = what the adc_dec link stream sends: round half away from zero (lroundf), saturate to -8388608..8388607. Sample indices are 64-bit (u64, D-018) in the firmware; they never wrap.
build: Firmware builds the dsp/trigger sources with -ffp-contract=off (no fused multiply-add).

tolerance.note: abs on expected = 10x the larger of the FMA-emulation and float64-reference errors (floor 1e-3); codes may differ by 1 where a value lies within rounding error of a half; expected_valid must match exactly.
